title: KaarigarAI
subtitle: AI Marketplace Assistant for Indian Artisans
content: From Your Hands to the World

title: The Artisan's Struggle
content: India has 7 Million artisans, yet less than 3% sell online.
bullets: No Digital Skills: Cataloging and SEO take years to learn
Language Barriers: Global marketplaces operate in English
Pricing Confusion: Handmade crafts are severely underpriced without market data

title: The Solution: KaarigarAI
content: A multimodal AI agent that empowers artisans to sell globally using just a photo.
bullets: Heritage Story Generator: Authentic craft backgrounds
Marketplace Copy: SEO-rich listings and tags
Smart Appraisals: Data-driven pricing suggestions
Multilingual: Input in Hindi, output in English

title: The Tech Stack
content: Built for scale, speed, and accessibility.
bullets: Frontend: React + Tailwind CSS + Vite
Backend: Node.js Express Server
Brain: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro Vision API
Language: Google Cloud Translation API
Accessibility: Twilio WhatsApp Webhook

title: System Architecture
content: How KaarigarAI processes an artisanal artifact.

title: Live Demo Flow
content: From snapped photo to global marketplace.
bullets: 1. Artisan uploads a photo of Madhubani art
2. Gemini Vision analyzes the craft style, colors, and subject
3. KaarigarAI generates an Etsy-ready listing in under 10 seconds

title: Why Google Cloud?
content: Powering the next generation of rural empowerment.
bullets: Gemini Multimodal API: Unmatched computer vision for analyzing complex ethnic crafts
Translation API: Bridging the vernacular divide flawlessly
Agentspace & Firebase: Fast, secure, and reliable serverless infrastructure
